Given Expression: E ÷ F - G x H + K

E ÷ F: E is the father of F.

This confirms E is male.

F - G: F is the sister of G.

This confirms F is female.

G x H: G is the wife of H.

This confirms G is female and H is male.

H + K: H is the son of K.

This confirms H is male.
